text.tspan: Remove "bob" from the list: count shifts, for_each doesn't (tested)
count: [1] changes bob → carol, [2] is destroyed (for a real aws_iam_user the name change = destroy + create). for_each: only bob goes.
count: N identical copies or on/off switch (count = var.enabled ? 1 : 0).
for_each: a set/map of DIFFERENT things (IAM users, subnets per AZ, EKS node groups). Migrate with moved {} blocks.
